experimental_semantics.wt_offset_note: No WT row in the parquet. The source column is a WT-relative ddG and the value distribution agrees (mostly negative, continuous, no pile-up at the range ends), so 0.0 is the convention used; it is not verified from the data. Any error is a per-domain constant: within-domain Spearman/Pearson/OLS-slope-with-intercept are invariant to it; eps_exp signs and magnitudes are not interpretable and uncentered values are not pooled across domains.
experimental_semantics.additive_null_note: Fit of DMS(AB) on DMS(A)+DMS(B). A slope well below 1 indicates strong GLOBAL (nonspecific) epistasis, so the intercept does NOT identify the WT reference.

spearman.kind: residue-pair block (residual dependence via shared singles)

pearson.kind: residue-pair block (residual dependence via shared singles)

slope.kind: residue-pair block (residual dependence via shared singles)

decoding_noise_reliability.caveats: Two replicates on n=60 pairs: the reliability point estimate is itself noisy. sqrt(reliability) bounds Pearson attenuation from MODEL DECODING NOISE ALONE under independent equal-variance additive errors; it is not a Spearman correction and not a total-noise ceiling (experimental noise attenuates further).

reliability_decomposition.note: between_group = reliability of per-position-pair means (does the model agree with itself about WHICH pairs couple); within_group = reliability of substitution-level deviations at a fixed pair.

decoding_noise_reliability_full_sample.note: Cross-seed over ALL analysed pairs: draw A is the main batch (seed 37), draw B a separate invocation at seed 38.

reliability_decomposition_full_sample.note: between_group = reliability of per-position-pair means (does the model agree with itself about WHICH pairs couple); within_group = reliability of substitution-level deviations at a fixed pair.

secondary_detrended.note: eps_exp replaced by the residual of DMS(AB) on a quadratic in DMS(A)+DMS(B) (global-epistasis detrending), fitted in-sample on these pairs: descriptive, not a held-out claim.

ci_residue_pair_block_spearman.kind: residue-pair block (residual dependence via shared singles)

held_out.note: Group-disjoint by residue pair; distinct pairs still share individual single mutations, so train/test are not fully independent.

paired_delta_ci_pearson.kind: paired block bootstrap of delta pearson (full - additive)

paired_delta_ci_spearman.kind: paired block bootstrap of delta spearman (full - additive)

within_residue_pair.note: Per position-pair Spearman of eps_exp on eps_model across substitution identities (groups with n>=20). No cross-pair dependence; the sign test below treats each position pair as one unit.

contact_split_abs_eps_model.note: Under-powered in sub-question A; reported for continuity only.
